g.text: UML sequence - exact consent to one periodic financial effect
stage offer(exact published calculation policy, key)
derive financial terms V1; retain material + digest
accept(account, offer, displayed digest, explicit true, key)
lock scope / account; recheck current sole owner
atomic full consent + key + redacted outbox
stage(consent ID, explicit GL counter account)
immutable activation; first future whole period
discover next closed UTC due period
commit scoped intent, then link durable job
ordered financial account locks; native clock + source prefix
unique immutable finalization; close account-period watermark
balanced original journal + unique receipt + outbox atomically
propose exact original periodic reversal + reason
verify original period proof; new linked reversal
Original journals and finalized basis never change.
Retries/concurrent jobs recover the same native receipt.
